implementation.targetScope: Documented sequence operations and current/app ProseMirror history callers. History implementation and application adoption are separate.

changes: Private AVL tree with 128-element maximum leaves and structural sharing.
Input and flattened arrays are detached from sequence storage; elements retain identity.
Flatten allocates one output array; getters/length are read-only and no runtime dependencies remain.
Fractional/NaN boundaries and out-of-range iteration throw rather than producing shape-dependent values.
